import msal
import requests


def register_user(payload, config=None):
    config = config or {}
    app = msal.ConfidentialClientApplication(
        config['client_id'], authority=f"https://login.microsoftonline.com/{config['tenant_id']}",
        client_credential=config['client_secret'])
    token = app.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    response = requests.post('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users',
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']},
        json={'accountEnabled': True, 'displayName': payload['email'],
              'identities': [{'signInType': 'emailAddress', 'issuer': config['issuer'],
                              'issuerAssignedId': payload['email']}],
              'passwordProfile': {'password': payload['password'], 'forceChangePasswordNextSignIn': False},
              'passwordPolicies': 'DisablePasswordExpiration'}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'user_id': response.json()['id']}

import msal
import requests

from identity_client import get_client


def email_password_login(email, password, config=None):
    client = get_client(config)
    token = client.acquire_token_by_username_password(username=email, password=password, scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    return token

import msal

from identity_client import get_client


def refresh_session(refresh_token, config=None):
    client = get_client(config)
    token = client.acquire_token_by_refresh_token(refresh_token=refresh_token, scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph token refresh failed')
    return token

import requests

from identity_client import get_client


def password_reset(email, config=None):
    client = get_client(config)
    token = client.acquire_token_for_client(scopes=['https://graph.microsoft.com/.default'])
    if 'access_token' not in token:
        raise RuntimeError('Microsoft Graph authentication failed')
    response = requests.post('https://graph.microsoft.com/v1.0/users/{}/sendPasswordResetMail'.format(email),
        headers={'Authorization': 'Bearer ' + token['access_token']}, timeout=30)
    response.raise_for_status()
    return {'status': 'Password reset email sent'}

import requests


def translate_onboarding_copy(text, locale):
    response = requests.post('https://api.cognitive.microsofttranslator.com/translate?api-version=3.0&to=' + locale,
        headers={'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Key': os.getenv('TRANSLATOR_KEY'), 'Ocp-Apim-Subscription-Region': os.getenv('TRANSLATOR_REGION')},
        json=[{'text': text}])
    response.raise_for_status()
    return response.json()[0]['translations'][0]['text']

import boto3


def store_onboarding_notes(user_id, notes):
    dynamodb = boto3.resource('dynamodb')
    table = dynamodb.Table('OnboardingNotes')
    table.put_item(Item={'user_id': user_id, 'notes': notes})
